column3: The Captain screen reuses the project workspace (chat, conversation tabs, right pane) over a project-shaped summary of the Captain's space instead of a separate layout; pane views carry a scope (project or captain) so Files, Memory, Schedules and Drive stay project-only and Crew is Captain-only; the avatar is a round monogram because the web app has no yukiusagi avatar component yet; the edit dialog's model list is the keyed catalog and cannot clear a model once set, because captain.update has no way to unset it
column4: one chat, tab and pane implementation instead of two; avatarSeed is kept in the type for the avatar when it lands; captain.get is re-read only when home changes a crew row so heartbeats cost nothing
column5: web typecheck and build; gate lint and types pass; Playwright walkthrough against wrangler dev on capy/captains-crews-and-side: create, crew add, settings, side thread, crew remove, archive, with zero op errors
